name: Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd.
summary: Fuxin Dare Automotive Parts Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of automotive parts systems in China and internationally. It operates through Pumps and Electronics Products; Noise Reduction, Heat Insulation and Lightweight Products, and Automotive Interior Products segments. The company offers noise reduction (NHV), thermal, and lightweight products comprising interior solutions consisting of air ducts, dash inner, roof reinforcements, I/P lower panels, door water shields, and rear shelves; exterior solutions, including underbody panels, NVH tunnels, tank insulators and brackets, brake shields, and retaining straps; powertrai…
